summary: Service-relevant components for the timing-belt procedure, plus orientation context. Every dimension and placement is an estimate from photograph proportions scaled to the published 86 mm bore. No component is measured, fitment-confirmed or reviewed.

components.name: Cylinder block
components.description: Shown as an orientation volume. Internal passages, ribs and mounts are not modeled.
gaps: Casting shape, mounting bosses and bore spacing are not modeled.

components.name: Oil pan
components.description: Orientation volume.

components.name: Cylinder head
components.description: Carries the intake and exhaust camshafts. Shown as an orientation volume with camshaft nose bosses.

components.name: Cylinder head covers
components.description: Intake-side and exhaust-side covers grouped as one record.

components.name: Intake manifold
components.description: On the engine left side. Runners and plenum grouped.
gaps: Runner shape and plenum routing are illustrative.

components.name: Exhaust manifold
components.description: On the engine right side. Heat shields omitted.
gaps: Split and collector arrangement not represented.

components.name: Water pump
components.description: Driven by the accessory belt on this engine, not by the timing belt.
gaps: Mounting position estimated; body shape simplified.

components.name: Timing belt
components.description: Toothed belt that connects the crankshaft timing pulley to both camshaft timing pulleys.
gaps: Tooth count, pitch and length not established. The modeled path is the tangent hull of estimated pulley positions.

components.name: Crankshaft timing pulley
components.description: Keyed toothed pulley behind the external crankshaft pulley.
gaps: Radius set to half the camshaft pulley radius because the camshafts turn at half crankshaft speed. Absolute size not measured.

components.name: Crankshaft timing pulley retaining plate
components.description: Plate installed with the crankshaft timing pulley.
gaps: Exact name, side and shape unconfirmed.

components.name: Timing belt guide
components.description: Dished washer in front of the crankshaft timing pulley.

components.name: Exhaust camshaft timing pulley
components.description: Fixed-timing pulley on the exhaust camshaft.
gaps: Tooth count and timing mark not modeled.

components.name: Exhaust camshaft pulley bolt
components.description: Center bolt.

components.name: Intake camshaft timing pulley (VVT-i controller)
components.description: Toothed pulley combined with the VVT-i phasing mechanism on the intake camshaft. The internal vanes are not modeled.

components.name: VVT-i pulley factory-set bolts
components.description: Do not loosen. Shown so they can be recognized and left alone.
gaps: Bolt circle radius and angular spacing estimated.

components.name: VVT-i oil control hardware
components.description: Camshaft timing oil control valve and oil supply hardware, grouped.
gaps: Location, pipe routing and the parts in this group are not confirmed.

components.name: Timing belt idler
components.description: Smooth idler loaded by the hydraulic tensioner. Pulley, bearing and bracket are grouped.
gaps: Placed on the slack side inferred from clockwise rotation. Position unconfirmed.
Presence of a second idler unconfirmed.

components.name: Idler bolt
components.description: Idler pivot bolt.

components.name: Hydraulic timing belt tensioner
components.description: Hydraulic actuator that loads the idler. It is retained with a pin during installation.

components.name: Tensioner dust boot
components.description: Rubber boot on the tensioner pushrod.

components.name: Tensioner mounting bolts
components.description: Two bolts, tightened alternately during installation.

components.name: Rear timing belt covers
components.description: Rear plates behind the camshaft pulleys. The source names covers No.1 to No.4; the numbering of these rear plates is unresolved.

components.name: No.1 timing belt cover (lower)
components.description: Lower cover behind the crankshaft pulley. Carries a reference used by the factory sequence.

components.name: Upper timing belt cover
components.description: Upper cover over the camshaft pulleys. Recorded as No.2 pending confirmation.
gaps: Numbering (No.2/No.3) unconfirmed. May be two covers.

components.name: Crankshaft pulley
components.description: External grooved pulley that drives the accessory belt. Separate from the toothed crankshaft timing pulley behind it.
gaps: Damper ring and groove count not established.

components.name: Crankshaft pulley bolt
components.description: Loosened and tightened with the holding tool.

components.name: Accessory drive belt
components.description: V-ribbed belt for the external accessories.
gaps: Routing is the tangent hull of estimated pulley positions, not a routing diagram.

components.name: Accessory belt tensioner
components.description: Spring-loaded tensioner for the accessory belt.

components.name: Water pump pulley
components.description: Accessory-belt-driven pulley.

components.name: Power-steering pump
components.description: Moved for access to the upper timing cover.
gaps: Reservoir, lines and exact position not modeled.

components.name: Power-steering pump front bracket
components.description: Front bracket removed with the pump.

components.name: Alternator
components.description: Driven by the accessory belt. Not removed in this procedure.

components.name: A/C compressor
components.description: Driven by the accessory belt. Not removed in this procedure.

components.name: Radiator assembly
components.description: Radiator core, tanks and fan equipment grouped as one removal unit.
gaps: Fans, shroud and cooler lines not separated.

components.name: Upper radiator hose
components.description: Engine outlet to radiator inlet.

components.name: Lower radiator hose
components.description: Radiator outlet to engine inlet.

components.name: Engine under-cover
components.description: Splash shield under the engine.
gaps: Outline and fastener count not established.
